title: Intraday patterns: does the first 15 minutes' direction carry through the rest of the day (indices and liquid stocks), does the last hour extend the day's move, does a wide opening range come before a wide rest of the day, and are expiry-day afternoons more volatile?
hypothesis: The first 15 minutes set the day's direction (the rest of the day moves the same way), the last hour extends the move made until 14:30, a wide 09:15-09:30 range comes before a wider range for the rest of the day, and on an index's own expiry day the 13:30-15:30 move is bigger than on other days.

data.index: silver/kite_index/minute 2015-2023 (NIFTY 50, NIFTY BANK) via india.ocstudy.load_index; days with fewer than 360 minutes or no 09:15 bar are skipped
data.stocks: silver/kite_5m 2015-2023, the 50 most liquid stocks of each day by liq_rank
data.expiries: the index's own option expiry days from the bhavcopy expiries (silver/fo_calendar, OPTIDX), weekly Bank Nifty from 27 May 2016 and weekly Nifty from 11 Feb 2019

definitions.first15 rest_signed: sign of the 09:15 open to 09:30 close move times the 09:30 to 15:29 close move (per day; a zero first move is left out); a positive mean = continuation
definitions.lasthour extends: sign of the open to 14:30 move times the 14:30 to 15:29 move; indices pooled
definitions.or15_top dayrange: rest-of-day range = (high - low after 09:30) / the 09:30 price; days whose 09:15-09:30 range (as a share of the open) is in the top third of that index's previous 250 sessions against days in the bottom third
definitions.expiry_pm absmove: absolute 13:30 to 15:29 move on the index's own expiry days against its other days; indices pooled
definitions.descriptive: for Nifty 2015-2023: the mean return and the mean absolute return of each 15-minute bucket of the day, with no verdict

statistics.signed: first15 and lasthour: calendar-month means of the signed move, t across months (same-day outcomes, so months are independent blocks)
statistics.split: or15_top and expiry_pm: per calendar month the mean of 'on' days against the mean of 'off' days, Welch t across monthly block means (a month counts on a side with at least 1 'on' and 3 'off' days)
statistics.verdict: india/registry.record standard rule; 16 blocks per period

bar.note: family 'intraday' (28) plus IB1's 8 plus these 6; k frozen at 42

not_claimed: Descriptive features of the trading day; no rule is changed by a pass.
